text: The open carriage, a comfortable landau
why: The Inspector mentions an open carriage in ¶50, and ¶51 calls it a comfortable landau.
¶51 says the Colonel sits with his hat tilted over his eyes.

text: Thursday evening, driving in the landau through Tavistock
why: ¶13 places them on Thursday morning and ¶47 has them reach Tavistock that evening, so the drive is Thursday evening.

text: What Inspector Gregory reports on the drive
why: ¶51 says Gregory poured out remarks and set out his theory during the drive. The label adds no content.
